description_en: Retrieves hot data from SQL audit logs
name: GetDasSQLLogHotData

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database instance
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query. This value must be a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

You can query only data that is generated after you enable DAS Enterprise Edition. The start time cannot be earlier than seven days before the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

只能查询开启DAS企业版后的数据，查询开始时间最大不能早于当前时间7天
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This value must be a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

The end time must be later than the start time. The time range cannot exceed one day
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，且查询开始时间和查询结束时间的间隔不能超过1天
parameters.name: end

parameters.help_en:
The query keyword.

Fuzzy search is supported. You can specify up to 10 keywords. Separate multiple keywords with a space. For example: a1 b2 c3
parameters.help_zh:
关键字。

支持模糊查询；最多支持10个关键字组合查询，关键字之间以空格分隔。例如：a1 b2 c3
parameters.name: query_keyword

parameters.help_en:
The database account.

You can specify multiple database accounts. Separate multiple accounts with a space. For example: `user1 user2 user3`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号。

支持多个数据库账号组合查询，数据库账号间以空格分隔，例如：`user1 user2 user3`
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The database name.

You can specify multiple database names. Separate multiple names with a space. For example: `DB1 DB2 DB3`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名。

支持多个数据库名组合查询，数据库名间以空格分隔，例如：`DB1 DB2 DB3`
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The client IP address.

You can specify multiple client IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with a space. For example: `IP1 IP2 IP3`
parameters.help_zh:
客户端IP地址。

支持多个客户端IP地址组合查询，客户端IP地址间以空格分隔，例如：`IP1 IP2 IP3`
parameters.name: host_address

parameters.help_en:
The logical operator to use with multiple keywords. Valid values:

or

and
parameters.help_zh:
多个关键字的逻辑关系。

or：或。
and：与
parameters.name: logical_operator

parameters.help_en: The maximum execution time in microseconds. Returns SQL statements that have an execution time less than this value
parameters.help_zh: 最大执行耗时 ，单位为微秒。查询执行耗时小于该参数值的SQL语句
parameters.name: max_latancy

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of scanned rows. Returns SQL statements that scanned fewer than this number of rows
parameters.help_zh: 最大扫描行数 ，查询扫描行数小于该参数值的SQL语句
parameters.name: max_scan_rows

parameters.help_en: The minimum execution time in microseconds. Returns SQL statements with an execution time greater than or equal to this value
parameters.help_zh: 最小执行耗时 ，单位为微秒。查询执行耗时大于等于该参数值的SQL语句
parameters.name: min_latancy

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of scanned rows. Returns SQL statements that scanned at least this number of rows
parameters.help_zh: 最小扫描行数 ，查询扫描行数大于等于该参数值的SQL语句
parameters.name: min_scan_rows

parameters.help_en: The SQL type
parameters.help_zh:
SQL语句的类型。取值：
select
update
delete
parameters.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en: The execution state. Set this parameter to 0 to query for successfully executed SQL statements. You can also specify an error code to query for the corresponding SQL statements
parameters.help_zh: 执行结果，输入0时表示查询执行成功的SQL，您也可以输入具体的错误码，查询对应的SQL
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The thread ID.

You can specify multiple thread IDs. Separate multiple IDs with a space. For example: `657 658 659`
parameters.help_zh:
线程ID。

支持多个线程ID组合查询，线程ID间以空格分隔，例如：`线程ID1 线程ID2 线程ID3`
parameters.name: thread_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Pages start from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的页码，从1开始，默认为1
parameters.name: page_numbers

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 5 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询每页最大记录数。取值范围：5～100
parameters.name: max_records_per_page

parameters.help_en:
The sort key. Valid values:

ScanRows: scanned rows.

UpdateRows: updated rows.

Consume: execution time.

OriginTime: The execution start time.

ReturnRows: returned rows
parameters.help_zh:
排序依据。

ScanRows：扫描行数。
UpdateRows：更新行数。
Consume：耗时。
OriginTime：执行时间。
ReturnRows：返回行数
parameters.name: sort_key

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

ASC: ascending

DESC: descending
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。
ASC：正序。
DESC：倒序
parameters.name: sort_method

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

This parameter is required if the database instance is a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

对于PolarDB MySQL版实例，需要提供节点ID
parameters.name: child_db_instance_ids

parameters.help_zh: 预留参数，暂不支持

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
parameters.help_zh: 预留参数，暂不支持
parameters.name: min_spill_cnt

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
parameters.help_zh: 预留参数，暂不支持
parameters.name: max_spill_cnt

parameters.help_en: The transaction ID
parameters.help_zh: 事务ID
parameters.name: transaction_id

parameters.help_en: The SQL execution error code. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/409804.html operation to obtain the error code
parameters.help_zh: SQL执行错误码，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/409804.html获取错误码
parameters.name: fail

List.description_en: A list of the returned data

items.description_en: The SQL insight and audit data

Ext.description_zh: 扩展信息字段，备用参数

LockTime.description_en: The lock wait time, in microseconds

PhysicAsyncRead.description_en: The number of physical asynchronous reads

PhysicSyncRead.description_en: The number of physical synchronous reads

State.description_zh: 状态。返回0时表示执行成功，否则返回错误码

Message.description_en:
The response message.

If the request succeeds, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message is returned, which may include an error code
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_zh:
